title: SMS workflow reminder retry count tracking

comments.text: "This condition deletes reminders with retryCount > 1, meaning reminders are deleted after just one retry attempt." Suggests a higher threshold such as > 3 or > 5.
"No maximum retry limit is enforced. Without a cap (e.g., retryCount < 5), reminders could be retried indefinitely." Flags performance risk from unbounded retries on the retryCount + 1 update.
